2609.02440.title: Towards One-for-All Robustness Across a Continuum of Threat Levels
2609.02440.paper_summary: Adversarially robust models often overfit to a specific attack budget, necessitating multiple specialized models for diverse and dynamic adversarial environments, a strategy that becomes fundamentally intractable as the threat space grows. This raises an open challenge: can we achieve strong robustness across a continuum of threat levels within a single model? We propose the Threat Conditional Network (TCN), grounded in a representation factorization framework that decomposes representation learning into a threat-invariant shared backbone and a lightweight threat-conditional adaptor. TCN conditions a single model on the perturbation level via Fourier-based embeddings and channel-wise affine modulation, and is trained against a distribution over perturbation budgets, enabling flexible and seamless adaptation across an infinite continuum of threat levels during inference. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny-ImageNet show that TCN matches or surpasses a full ensemble of budget-specialized models with a single set of parameters, generalizes to unseen perturbation budgets, and transfers robustly under mismatched threat conditions, with only 4.6\% parameter overhead. These contributions chart a promising path toward adaptive and generalizable robustness in dynamic and diverse threat environments.
2609.02440.paper_summary_zh: 對抗性強健模型通常會過度擬合特定的攻擊預算，這需要為多樣且動態的對抗環境建立多個專門模型，隨著威脅空間的擴大，這一策略變得根本不可行。這提出了一個未解的挑戰：我們能否在單一模型中實現對一系列威脅水平的強健性？我們提出了威脅條件網絡（TCN），該網絡基於一種表示因式分解框架，將表示學習分解為一個威脅不變的共享骨幹和一個輕量級的威脅條件適配器。TCN通過基於傅里葉的嵌入和通道級的仿射調製，對單一模型進行擾動水平的條件化，並針對擾動預算的分佈進行訓練，使其在推理過程中能夠靈活且無縫地適應無限的威脅水平。在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和Tiny-ImageNet上的大量實驗表明，TCN在單一參數集下匹配或超越了一整套預算專門模型，能夠對未見的擾動預算進行泛化，並在不匹配的威脅條件下穩健轉移，僅增加4.6\%的參數開銷。這些貢獻為在動態和多樣的威脅環境中實現自適應和可泛化的強健性鋪平了有希望的道路。
